content: Shaurya Joshi calls insurance agent Neha Kapoor to discuss either reinstating his old health policy or upgrading to a new one with dental and vision coverage. Neha offers a one-time 5% discount if Shaurya upgrades within 48 hours, though the new policy will still cost about 10% more than his old one. The call concludes with Neha asking Shaurya to make a decision between reinstating the old policy or taking the discounted new one.

action_items: Shaurya to decide whether to reinstate the old policy or upgrade to the new one with the 5% discount within 48 hours
